I have a dataset of 2D coordinates located at `/home/user/spatial_data.csv` and I need to perform mesh refinement and domain decomposition on this data. The dataset contains `x,y` coordinates (comma-separated, no header) within the domain $X \in [0, 1]$ and $Y \in [0, 1]$. 

My task is to start with the domain $[0, 1] \times [0, 1]$ and create an initial $2 \times 2$ grid. Then, I need to refine the grid by recursively splitting cells into 4 equal sub-quadrants if a cell contains more than 50 points, up to a maximum depth of 3. 

For each leaf cell in the final mesh, I need to approximate its theoretical unnormalized mass using a 2D Gaussian distribution centered at $\mu_x=0.5, \mu_y=0.5$ with standard deviation $\sigma=0.2$. I also need to calculate the normalized theoretical probability for each cell and the empirical probability based on the number of points in each cell. 

Finally, I need to compute the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence from the theoretical probability to the empirical probability. The final result should be written to a JSON file at `/home/user/model_fit.json` with the following format:
```json
{
  "total_cells": <integer, total number of leaf cells in the final mesh>,
  "max_depth_reached": <integer, the maximum refinement depth actually reached>,
  "kl_divergence": <float, rounded to 4 decimal places>
}
```

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

cat > /home/user/spatial_model.cpp <<'CPP'
#include <iostream>
#include <fstream>
#include <sstream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

struct Point {
    double x, y;
};

struct Cell {
    double xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax;
    int depth;
    int count;
    bool leaf;
    std::vector<Cell> children;

    Cell(double x0, double y0, double x1, double y1, int d)
        : xmin(x0), ymin(y0), xmax(x1), ymax(y1), depth(d), count(0), leaf(true) {}
};

bool contains(const Cell& c, const Point& p) {
    const double eps = 1e-12;
    if (p.x < c.xmin - eps || p.x > c.xmax + eps) return false;
    if (p.y < c.ymin - eps || p.y > c.ymax + eps) return false;

    bool rightmost = std::fabs(c.xmax - 1.0) < eps;
    bool topmost = std::fabs(c.ymax - 1.0) < eps;

    // Lower boundaries are inclusive; upper boundaries are exclusive,
    // except for the global maximum boundaries x=1.0 and y=1.0.
    if (std::fabs(p.x - c.xmax) < eps && !rightmost) return false;
    if (std::fabs(p.y - c.ymax) < eps && !topmost) return false;

    return true;
}

int countPoints(const Cell& c, const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    int cnt = 0;
    for (const auto& p : points) {
        if (contains(c, p)) ++cnt;
    }
    return cnt;
}

void splitCell(Cell& cell, const std::vector<Point>& points) {
    cell.count = countPoints(cell, points);

    if (cell.count > 50 && cell.depth < 3) {
        double midx = (cell.xmin + cell.xmax) / 2.0;
        double midy = (cell.ymin + cell.ymax) / 2.0;
        int nd = cell.depth + 1;

        cell.children.emplace_back(cell.xmin, cell.ymin, midx, midy, nd);
        cell.children.emplace_back(midx, cell.ymin, cell.xmax, midy, nd);
        cell.children.emplace_back(cell.xmin, midy, midx, cell.ymax, nd);
        cell.children.emplace_back(midx, midy, cell.xmax, cell.ymax, nd);
        cell.leaf = false;

        for (auto& child : cell.children) {
            splitCell(child, points);
        }
    }
}

void collectLeaves(const Cell& cell, std::vector<const Cell*>& leaves) {
    if (cell.leaf) {
        leaves.push_back(&cell);
    } else {
        for (const auto& child : cell.children) {
            collectLeaves(child, leaves);
        }
    }
}

int maxDepthReached(const Cell& cell) {
    int md = cell.depth;
    for (const auto& child : cell.children) {
        md = std::max(md, maxDepthReached(child));
    }
    return md;
}

int main() {
    std::ifstream fin("/home/user/spatial_data.csv");
    if (!fin.is_open()) {
        std::cerr << "Failed to open spatial_data.csv" << std::endl;
        return 1;
    }

    std::vector<Point> points;
    std::string line;
    while (std::getline(fin, line)) {
        if (line.empty()) continue;
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r') line.pop_back();

        std::stringstream ss(line);
        std::string xs, ys;
        if (!std::getline(ss, xs, ',')) continue;
        if (!std::getline(ss, ys, ',')) continue;

        try {
            points.push_back({std::stod(xs), std::stod(ys)});
        } catch (...) {
        }
    }
    fin.close();

    // Initial 2x2 grid at depth 0.
    std::vector<Cell> roots;
    roots.emplace_back(0.0, 0.0, 0.5, 0.5, 0);
    roots.emplace_back(0.5, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5, 0);
    roots.emplace_back(0.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 0);
    roots.emplace_back(0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0);

    std::vector<const Cell*> leaves;
    int max_depth = 0;

    for (auto& root : roots) {
        splitCell(root, points);
        collectLeaves(root, leaves);
        max_depth = std::max(max_depth, maxDepthReached(root));
    }

    int total_cells = static_cast<int>(leaves.size());

    // Theoretical unnormalized masses q'_i = f(center) * Area.
    std::vector<double> qraw(total_cells, 0.0);
    double sumq = 0.0;
    const double denom = 2.0 * 0.2 * 0.2;

    for (int i = 0; i < total_cells; ++i) {
        const Cell* c = leaves[i];
        double xc = (c->xmin + c->xmax) / 2.0;
        double yc = (c->ymin + c->ymax) / 2.0;
        double area = (c->xmax - c->xmin) * (c->ymax - c->ymin);
        qraw[i] = std::exp(-(((xc - 0.5) * (xc - 0.5)) + ((yc - 0.5) * (yc - 0.5))) / denom) * area;
        sumq += qraw[i];
    }

    std::vector<double> Q(total_cells), P(total_cells);
    for (int i = 0; i < total_cells; ++i) {
        Q[i] = qraw[i] / sumq;
        P[i] = static_cast<double>(leaves[i]->count) / static_cast<double>(points.size());
    }

    double kl = 0.0;
    for (int i = 0; i < total_cells; ++i) {
        if (P[i] > 0.0) {
            kl += P[i] * std::log(P[i] / Q[i]);
        }
    }

    double rounded_kl = std::round(kl * 10000.0) / 10000.0;

    std::ofstream fout("/home/user/model_fit.json");
    fout << "{\n";
    fout << "  \"total_cells\": " << total_cells << ",\n";
    fout << "  \"max_depth_reached\": " << max_depth << ",\n";
    fout << "  \"kl_divergence\": " << std::fixed << std::setprecision(4) << rounded_kl << "\n";
    fout << "}\n";
    fout.close();

    std::cout << "Total points: " << points.size() << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Total cells: " << total_cells << std::endl;
    std::cout << "Max depth: " << max_depth << std::endl;
    std::cout << "KL divergence: " << rounded_kl << std::endl;

    return 0;
}

import csv, math, json

points=[]
with open('/home/user/spatial_data.csv') as f:
    for line in f:
        line=line.strip()
        if not line: continue
        parts=line.split(',')
        if len(parts)!=2: continue
        try:
            points.append((float(parts[0]), float(parts[1])))
        except:
            pass
print('points:', len(points))

class Cell:
    def __init__(self,x0,y0,x1,y1,d):
        self.x0=x0; self.y0=y0; self.x1=x1; self.y1=y1; self.depth=d
        self.children=[]; self.leaf=True

def contains(c,p):
    x,y=p; eps=1e-12
    if x<c.x0-eps or x>c.x1+eps: return False
    if y<c.y0-eps or y>c.y1+eps: return False
    if abs(x-c.x1)<eps and abs(c.x1-1.0)>eps: return False
    if abs(y-c.y1)<eps and abs(c.y1-1.0)>eps: return False
    return True

def cnt(c): return sum(1 for p in points if contains(c,p))

def split(c):
    c.count=cnt(c)
    if c.count>50 and c.depth<3:
        mx=(c.x0+c.x1)/2; my=(c.y0+c.y1)/2
        nd=c.depth+1
        c.children=[Cell(c.x0,c.y0,mx,my,nd), Cell(mx,c.y0,c.x1,my,nd), Cell(c.x0,my,mx,c.y1,nd), Cell(mx,my,c.x1,c.y1,nd)]
        c.leaf=False
        for ch in c.children: split(ch)

roots=[Cell(0,0,0.5,0.5,0), Cell(0.5,0,1,0.5,0), Cell(0,0.5,0.5,1,0), Cell(0.5,0.5,1,1,0)]
leaves=[]; maxd=0
for r in roots:
    split(r)
    st=[r]
    while st:
        n=st.pop(); maxd=max(maxd,n.depth)
        if n.leaf: leaves.append(n)
        else: st.extend(n.children)

print('leaf count:', len(leaves))
print('max depth:', maxd)
print('cell counts:', [c.count for c in leaves])
print('sum counts:', sum(c.count for c in leaves))

denom=2*0.2**2
sumq=0.0; qs=[]
for c in leaves:
    xc=(c.x0+c.x1)/2; yc=(c.y0+c.y1)/2
    area=(c.x1-c.x0)*(c.y1-c.y0)
    q=math.exp(-(((xc-0.5)**2)+((yc-0.5)**2))/denom)*area
    qs.append(q); sumq+=q
Q=[q/sumq for q in qs]
P=[c.count/len(points) for c in leaves]
kl=sum(p*math.log(p/q) for p,q in zip(P,Q) if p>0)
print('KL raw:', kl)
print('KL rounded:', round(kl,4))

out=json.load(open('/home/user/model_fit.json'))
print('JSON:', out)
print('Matches:', out['total_cells']==len(leaves) and out['max_depth_reached']==maxd and abs(out['kl_divergence']-round(kl,4))<1e-9)
